om.help:
om — OfficeMatrix for agents

  node om.js office                          your office: name, AI team, missions
  node om.js missions                        the office's missions (running first)
  node om.js new "request" [options]         starts a mission and prints its id
      --mode relay|delphi|council            relay (one after another, code), delphi (each AI writes its own version,
                                             then they review: unbiased research), council (everyone proposes and a
                                             chair synthesizes: strategy, plans)              [default: delphi]
      --team claude,codex                    AIs that work (only those allowed in the office)
      --rounds N                             review rounds (1-20)                             [default: 2]
      --auto                                 let the AIs decide when it is done (capped at --rounds)
      --score N                              minimum score to approve (1-10)                  [default: 9]
      --parallel N                           AIs working at once in delphi/council            [default: 1]
      --chair ID                             who synthesizes in council
      --attach path                          file for everyone to read (repeatable; PDF, docx, xlsx, images…)
  node om.js status ID                       phase, round, who is working and what they are thinking
  node om.js wait ID [--max-min 240]         waits until it ends (checks every 30 s) and shows the result
  node om.js result ID [--download folder]   what was delivered and where; --download fetches the deliverables
  node om.js file ID path [dest]             downloads one file from the mission
  node om.js intervene ID "directive"        a mid-cycle instruction (read on their next turn)
  node om.js stop ID                         stops the cycle

  The Spanish commands (oficina, misiones, nueva, estado, esperar, resultado, archivo, intervenir, detener)
  and options (--modo, --equipo, --rondas, --nota, --a-la-vez, --presidente, --adjunto, --bajar) also work.
  Language: OM_LANG=en|es

  Environment: OM_URL={url}  OM_LLAVE={key}

wizard.instruction:
When you receive a webhook from OfficeMatrix, look at tipo.
- If tipo is ping, send ONE POST to the responder_a URL with JSON {"texto":"pong"}.
- If tipo is turno, read brief and archivos and do the turn as formato asks. When you finish, send ONE POST to responder_a with JSON {"texto":"your answer"}. End the text with the block formato names.
- If tipo is chat, read mensaje and historial and answer in a short conversation. Send ONE POST to responder_a with JSON {"texto":"your reply"}. Do not add a SCORE block.
Call responder_a only once: the URL works a single time.
If Grok Bot asks you to approve the outgoing POST (Auto-review), approve it the first time for this host, or add an Allow automatically rule for that POST. An approval card from a routine expires after about 10 minutes and then the reply is not sent.
